messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "Do not take two doses at once to make up for a missed one"
set: ["Do not take two doses at once to make up for a missed one", "do not take two doses to make up for a missed dose", "do not take two doses at once", "do not take two doses at one time", "do not use two doses at one time", "do not use two doses of semaglutide at one time", "do not take two 10 mg tablets at once", "do not use extra medicine to make up the missed dose", "do not take a missed dose during the day", "do not double up to catch up", "do not take extra doses between scheduled doses", "one to two additional doses given at intervals of 4 to 6 hours", "do not double up on a day you were not meant to take a dose", "do not take another dose for at least 24 hours", "once at room temperature, do not return to refrigerator", "do not take to lose weight"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [
    "do not take two doses to make up for a missed dose",
    "do not take two doses at once",
    "do not take two doses at one time",
    "do not use two doses at one time",
    "do not use extra medicine to make up the missed dose",
    "do not take a missed dose during the day",
    "do not double up to catch up",
    "do not take extra doses between scheduled doses",
    "do not double up on a day you were not meant to take a dose",
    "do not take another dose for at least 24 hours"
  ],
  "alias": "do not take two doses at once to make up for a missed one"
}
